human_review.scope: Qualitative continuous review of the two existing presets, not per-case numerical scores
human_review.original_feedback: val_musicreplace_text_oracle_neutral_v1是舞蹈,其他几个在【先复审教师舞蹈上界】中的配置都是摆pose. 教师空间·pca256是唯一像舞蹈的,但是存在一些肢体反转等的问题,其他的教师空间·w256和教师空间·ln256还是类似摆pose
human_review.latest_pca256_feedback: 教师空间·pca256也有一些但是还是有之前说的很多问题例如肢体液化、模糊、反转等问题
human_review.projection_round_note: W256/LN255/PCA256 are the already-completed previous-round teacher projections, not newly trained music students
human_review.ln_label_note: User called the LN variant ln256; the existing experiment is LN255 with actual affine rank 255
